settings.help: Advertise HDR10 to displays that list PQ in their EDID.
settings.title: HDR10

settings.help: Scan out 30-bit surfaces on mode changes.
settings.title: 10-bit colour

settings.help: Let WindowServer request variable refresh on displays that support it.
settings.title: Variable refresh rate (G-Sync Compatible / Adaptive-Sync)

settings.help: Bits per colour channel on the link; default lets the driver pick.
settings.title: Output colour depth

settings.help: Pixel format on the link; default lets the driver pick.
settings.title: Output colour format

settings.help: Full or limited RGB range; default lets the driver pick.
settings.title: Output dynamic range

settings.help: Saturation gain, 0 to 200; 100 leaves colours alone.
settings.title: Digital vibrance

settings.help: Offer desktops larger than the panel and scale them down. Reserves scanout memory.
settings.title: Dynamic super resolution (render above the panel's resolution)

settings.help: Back scaled modes with a desktop up to twice the panel raster.
settings.title: HiDPI 'looks like' modes

settings.help: Offer extra resolutions on a rotated head.
settings.title: Scaled modes on rotated displays

settings.help: Bit mask of framebuffer indices that form one logical display, for example 3 for the first two. 0 or default turns it off.
settings.title: Surround (several displays as one)

settings.help: On by default; off disables brightness control through the panel's AUX channel.
settings.title: Laptop panel brightness over the display link

settings.help: One number for every application (60) or a list per application (Game=60,*=0). 10 to 1000; 0 is unlimited. Never applies to WindowServer.
settings.title: Frame-rate limit

settings.help: How many parts of GPU work may be queued ahead, 1 to 32 (default 16). A low number cuts input lag and can cost frame rate. Applies to every application, the desktop included.
settings.title: Low-latency mode (GPU work queued ahead)

settings.help: Size at which the shader cache is trimmed (default 2048). 0 turns trimming off.
settings.title: Shader cache size limit (MB)

settings.help: On by default; off turns every shipped per-application profile off.
settings.title: Built-in per-application profiles

settings.help: On by default for stability; off places it in video memory (faster in some games, unsafe for the desktop).
settings.title: Keep CPU-written memory in system RAM
